## Type of change

- [ ] `feat` — new conversion capability, output option, or CLI flag
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix or extraction/conversion correction
- [ ] `perf` — performance improvement
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `chore` — tooling, CI, dependencies

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests pass locally (`npm test`)
- [ ] Type check passes (`npm run typecheck`)
- [ ] The build compiles (`npm run build`)
- [ ] New behavior (feature or fix) is covered by a test
- [ ] No heavy or unauthorized dependencies were added
- [ ] The conversion core stays edge-compatible (no Node-only APIs)
- [ ] Documentation / README updated if applicable
